historical_record.description: The Works Progress Administration began the preliminary planning of the arboretum in Golden Gate Park.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved Prentiss French's 1949 master plan for the Strybing Arboretum and Botanical Gardens, amended to make room for an Exposition and Exhibit Hall in its southeast corner, by the Ninth Avenue and Lincoln Way entrance, and for a Pan-American Grove in its western part.
